server.name: io.github.devmster/x402-trinity
server.description: Give an agent a wallet. Pays for x402 resources within hard limits. Base + USDC, gasless.
server.title: x402 Trinity

environmentVariables.description: Private key of the wallet that pays. Use a dedicated wallet holding only what you would accept losing. The server refuses to start without it.
environmentVariables.name: X402_PRIVATE_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Hard ceiling for a single payment, in atomic units (USDC has 6 decimals, so 50000 is $0.05). Required: a model decides when payments happen, so the cap cannot come from the model.
environmentVariables.name: X402_MAX_PER_REQUEST

environmentVariables.description: Lifetime ceiling across all payments, in atomic units. Required for the same reason as the per-request cap.
environmentVariables.name: X402_TOTAL_BUDGET

environmentVariables.description: Path to a file that makes the lifetime budget survive restarts. Without it the total resets every time the server starts.
environmentVariables.name: X402_BUDGET_FILE

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated hosts that may be paid. Anything else is refused however convincing the challenge looks.
environmentVariables.name: X402_ALLOW_HOSTS

environmentVariables.description: Networks to accept. Defaults to base.
environmentVariables.name: X402_NETWORKS

server.name: io.github.devon-clarkk/engraphy
server.description: Self-hosted MCP memory server: a typed knowledge graph on Postgres 16 and pgvector.
server.title: Engraphy

headers.description: Bearer <token>, where the token is issued by `engraphy-admin token create` against the space the client is entitled to. Every request to /mcp/ carries it; an unauthenticated call is refused with HTTP 401.
headers.name: Authorization

environmentVariables.description: libpq connection string for a Postgres 16 database with the pgvector extension, reached as the non-superuser `engraphy_app` role. Required: the server refuses to start without it, and refuses to start if the schema is behind (run `engraphy-admin migrate` first).
environmentVariables.name: ENGRAPHY_DATABASE_URL

environmentVariables.description: Interface the server binds. Containers reach their own loopback only, so a published container sets 0.0.0.0 and puts the boundary at the port publication and the reverse proxy.
environmentVariables.name: ENGRAPHY_BIND_HOST

environmentVariables.description: Port the server binds inside the container, matching the port in the transport URL.
environmentVariables.name: ENGRAPHY_BIND_PORT

tech.engraphy.requires: Postgres 16 with pgvector, and a bearer token issued by engraphy-admin
